physicalNotes: Radius 0.662 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Leleu et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-178 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A.211L/abstract): 460,553 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.647 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Leleu et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-178 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A.211L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4316 +/- 70 K from Leleu et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-178 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A.211L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
